name: Ishizuchi Quasi-National Park
description: Quasi-national park of Mt. Ishizuchi, Shikoku's highest peak (1,982 m) and one of the seven holy mountains, with its shrine chain and alpine plants.
notes: Managed by Ehime/Kochi. The summit shrine and the Omogo valley are the classic routes.
parking: Parking available at major visitor areas (fee varies)
